written_by: Claude Code, drafted from Las Positas College's 2025-2026 catalog for Ryan Saleh to check
notes: The usual order of course types for the Plan (spec 24 → Data, topic_order), from the Prerequisite lines in Las Positas College's 2025-2026 catalog on laspositascollege.edu (the current catalog on laspositas.curriqunet.com answers 403 to scripts, so it wasn't compared). before_topic is the prerequisite: { topic: cs2, before_topic: cs1 } means take cs1 first. The courses for each topic are the ones in college-courses-las-positas.json. A pair is written when a course of the topic has a prerequisite course that belongs to another topic in the same major. Left out: Recommended Course Preparation, prerequisites the catalog marks "May be taken concurrently" (CS 17 and MATH 10 on MATH 1 and CS 1, PHYS 1C on MATH 3), prerequisites that aren't course types here (precalculus, intermediate algebra, CHEM 31), and pick-one topics where only some of the choices have the prerequisite (PSYC 4 in psych-list-a, BUSN 1B and MATH 2 in econ-list-a, SOC 13 in sociology-list-a). Topics with no prerequisite have no row. Each row's source_url is the course page holding the prerequisite: biology-sequence after chemistry-general (BIO 1C needs CHEM 1A); managerial-accounting after financial-accounting (BUSN 1B needs BUSN 1A); chemistry-organic after chemistry-general (CHEM 12A needs CHEM 1B); cs2 after cs1 (CS 2 needs CS 1); comp-org after cs1 (CS 21 needs CS 1); calculus-multi after calculus-single (MATH 3 needs MATH 2); diff-eq after calculus-multi (MATH 5 needs MATH 3); diff-eq-and-linear-algebra after calculus-multi (MATH 5 needs MATH 3); diff-eq-and-linear-algebra after calculus-single (MATH 7 needs MATH 2); linear-algebra after calculus-single (MATH 7 needs MATH 2); physics-year after calculus-single (PHYS 1A needs MATH 1); physics-mechanics after calculus-single (PHYS 1A needs MATH 1); psych-research-methods after psych-intro (PSYC 25 needs PSYC C1000); psych-research-methods after statistics (PSYC 25 needs STAT C1000). From Fall 2026 BIO 1R replaces BIO 1A and BIO 1B (courses file); no row pointed at them, and BIO 1C's biology prerequisite stays inside biology-sequence. The biology-sequence row has a todo to check that BIO 1C still needs CHEM 1A. A second person checks each row against the catalog. Then run: npm run import -- data/raw/planning/topic-order.json --dry-run
